messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: optimize() function question.
parts:
Hi 퇴깽스,

Renjin uses an implementation of Brent's algorithm from the Apache Commons Math library that was developed independently from GNU R's algorithm, so I'm not surprised there are differences in the intermediate steps, but both implementations (GNU R and Renjin) converge at a number approaching 9.0, which is the true minimum for this function in the domain [9, 10]. 

It's true that GNU R's error is lower than that of Renjin:

> f(9.000066) < f(9.00022655192689)
[1] TRUE

If this difference affects your analysis, please open an issue at https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin. We can look at compiling the C coded used by R to JVM bytecode to obtain exactly the same results as GNU R.

Best,
Alex
